“
Ever since the Duke of Eltibule was mysteriously assassinated, all attempts to tame that land seem to run into bad luck.
— Loading screen
Eltibule
is a hilly region of the Council Lands which borders both
Serbule
and Sedgewick regions. The lands were once home to the Duchy of Eltibule, though in recent years the land is patronless as each member of the Eltibule family met an ill fate.
Eltibule Keep
, their former seat of power, has been maintained by former servants of the family and passing merchants. Years ago, many merchants and craftsmen were drawn to the Eltibule area because of Council promises to drive out the goblins and establish a new trade route starting in Eltibule and going through the
Kur Mountains
to
Gazluk
. The road was never started, only one guard house was built, and the army traveling to pacify the region vanished. The rocky landscape of the region prevents extensive farming, however some residents have managed to carve out homesteads near the most prominent feature of Eltibule, its many lakes.
Adventurers content with their combat prowess in
Serbule
often travel to
Eltibule
seeking greater foes and loot, drawn by rumors of strange fairy beasts and combative goblin clans.
Neighboring Regions
Serbule
The former Duchy of
Serbule
borders the region of
Eltibule
.
Kur Mountains
Eltibule offers the best route for travelers seeking to reach the cold lands of
Kur Mountains
.
Points of Interest
Eltibule Keep
Once governed by the Eltibule family and now maintained by one of their former servants, this castle's courtyard has become a home for weary travelers and and merchants. The interior has become overrun with Goblins and other monsters.
Hogan's Keep
An outpost at the foothills of the nearby mountains,
Hogan's Keep
provides shelter from the hostile monsters of
Eltibule
.
Hogan
himself is a master of the
Staff
.  Strange sounds can be heard from the castle's basement. Only
Hogan
can grant entry.
Antry Farm
A homestead and inn constructed by
Sie Antry
in anticipation of a new Council trade route.
Eltibule Family Graveyard
A solemn place, this graveyard and crypt hold the known corpses of the Eltibule family.
Red Wing Casino
Service Entrance
An employee bars your way. But perhaps there's another way around?
Eltibule's Grave Problem
Although
Uncovered Graves
can appear in many areas of Alharth, heavy rains and flooding lakes frequently reveal a significant number of graves in
Eltibule
. Most graves will contain either restless undead or items, however all graves are valuable points of interest for those with the
Corpse Talking
skill.
Eltibule's Weird Statues
Explorers of the
Eltibule
periphery may discover stone statues encircling the region. These eight statues are seemingly older than anything else in the area, and seemingly accept items as sacrifices. Individuals studying
Treasure Cartography
will find them valuable tools, although another usage is rumored to exist.

Animal Nexus
An unsettling breach into the fae realm, this portal has begun to cause ecological damage as fae creatures invade its surroundings.
Boarded up Basement
A model home designed to attract settlers, this house holds many secrets.
Goblin Dungeon
After dwarven laborers expanded the interior of
Eltibule Keep
, a tragedy befell the Eltibule family. Goblins from the neighboring lands soon invaded the tunnels, and the depths contain even stranger beings.
Hogan's Basement
Found under
Hogan's Keep
, this fortress basement is home to a Goblin clan in hiding.
Eltibule Crypt
The personal crypt of the Eltibule family.
Dark Chapel
For years, Eltibule has been rumored as the home of a mysterious cult. Strange cave systems with moving entrances, riddles, and rumors of untold power have led many explorers to an early demise.
Opening the
Dark Chapel
This involves a few steps:
1) Players must obtain a Gulgara's Sigil Key, these can be found as loot drops on
Crazed Cultist Idiots
, humans who are scattered around the Eltibule zone.
2) Players then must find the correct "Weird Statue"(See the Map on this page) that changes with each phase of the moon:
A) If you do not know the correct statue, you can take a
Moonstone
to each statue and give it as a sacrifice. If the statue consumes the moonstone and returns a treasure map, then it is the correct statue. If not, it is not the correct statue.
B) If you know the Lore Recipe Moon Phase Check, and know what statue the current Moon phase corresponds to you can go directly to the statue. (See below for a map of the statues and their moon phase.)
C) If you give your key to the wrong statue, you Lose the key and must find another. If you enter it into the correct statue it will be returned to you once you enter the Dungeon.
Note: The statues rotate clock-wise and the "Moon Phase" refers to the current phase of
Earth's
moon (GMT time zone).
